records.summary: The first Punjabi encyclopedia and perhaps the most comprehensive dictionary-encyclopedia on Sikhism, with around 65,000 entries, compiled over fourteen years.

records.summary: Macauliffe's magnum opus: a partial English translation of the Guru Granth Sahib together with Sikh history.

records.title: A History of the Sikhs

records.summary: Khushwant Singh's history of the Sikhs.

records.title: Varan Bhai Gurdas
records.subject: Sikh Studies
records.summary: Also known as Varan Gyan Ratnavali: forty vars traditionally attributed to Bhai Gurdas, popularly regarded as the key to the Sikh scriptures.
